MailAction.description: Input for use_mail tool - Jesse Vincent style single-tool pattern.

account.description: Account name for multi-account setups. Use 'accounts' action to list. Default account used if omitted.
account.title: Account

folder.description: IMAP folder path or URL (e.g., 'INBOX' or 'imap://x@y/INBOX/Sub')
folder.title: Folder

format.description: Body format, required for draft. 'markdown': rendered to HTML plus a plain alternative; a newline is a line break, a blank line a paragraph. 'plain': sent exactly as written, no HTML.
format.title: Format

payload.description: Action data: read=msg_id[:N|:full] | search=query | draft=JSON{to,subject,body,in_reply_to?,cc?,attachments?:[paths]} | edit=JSON{id,replacements:[{old,new}]} | flag=MSG_ID:+FLAG,-FLAG
payload.title: Payload

preview.description: Include body snippet (~100 chars) in list/search results. Required for list and search actions.
preview.title: Preview

MailAction.title: MailAction
